selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NextSeq 500 PE 2x42), right brain hemisphere
selected.samples: 24 male 3-month mice: genotype (WT, 5xFAD) x activity (sedentary, chronic 30-day wheel, acute 18 h/1-day wheel), n=4 per cell
selected.primary_estimand: effect of physical activity level (acute, chronic vs sedentary and acute vs chronic) on brain gene expression, within each genotype
selected.secondary_contrasts_not_run: 5xFAD vs WT within each activity level (S3.3.3; 141/477/14 DEGs) - genotype effect, not the exercise question
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none; one sample per mouse, independent groups
selected.normalization: DESeq2 size factors after removing Psen1, App, Thy1 from the count table (S2.5.p2)
selected.method: DESeq2 1.30.0 in R; counts from STAR+featureCounts (S2.5.p1-p2)
selected.model_scope: not_reported (pairwise comparisons within genotype; whether all 24 samples share one fit is not stated)

decisions.reason: Methods S2.1/S2.4/S2.5 and results S3.3.1 define within-genotype pairwise activity contrasts, DESeq2, BH padj<0.05 with no fold-change cutoff; genotype contrasts are secondary to the exercise question.

selected.comparison_to_paper: Qualitative pattern reproduced: only WT acute differs (vs sedentary and vs chronic); WT chronic vs sed and all three 5xFAD activity contrasts have 0 DEGs. Counts differ: WT acute vs sed 3828 vs paper 835, WT acute vs chronic 2028 vs paper 1617 (ranking of the two contrasts reversed). Chgb LFC matches (-0.274 / -0.256 vs paper -0.275 / -0.258) but padj ~1 here vs 0.02 in paper, suggesting the paper fit more samples per model (e.g. all 24 or per genotype) - model scope is not reported; pydeseq2 vs R DESeq2 1.30 may also contribute.
deviations: per-contrast 8-sample fits (paper model scope not reported)
selected.enrichment: GSEA Hallmark + Enrichr ORA up/down for the two WT acute contrasts; up: mRNA splicing/RNA processing, down: neuronal/synaptic and mitochondrial terms, consistent with S3.3.2.p2

decisions.reason: Paper route ran on paper threshold; n=4 per arm, residual df 6 (>=4), so not exploratory.
